propositions: An author-facing repair surface for a botched rebar-ticket trailer must expose retroactive commit linking on CLI, library, and MCP, validating all SHAs before recording any COMMITS event (all-or-nothing semantics).

A deterministic close-gate check must verify that linked commits' changed paths (from git show) are covered by the ticket's declared file_impact union or exempt globs, blocking close with specific path names if not.
Merge commits must be explicitly skipped in diff inspection to avoid false negatives from empty path lists, since merges author no content of their own.

Source code from source-(i) COMMITS events that lack local git refs must be skipped rather than errored to avoid false positives on foreign SHAs; source-(ii) commits reachable from HEAD must fail closed if git show fails.
The path-matching helper (glob_match with **/‑aware semantics) must be extracted to a shared DET module that does not import rebar.llm, with existing copies in prompts and registry delegating to it.

Parent tickets must not be false-blocked by child-owned paths declared only in child file_impact entries; discovery and file_impact union must use the same transitive id set (ticket plus all descendants).
